title: Typographic Attack Against VLM-based AI-generated Image Detection
title_zh: 针对基于VLM的AI生成图像检测的排版攻击

paragraphs.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection, providing natural-language explanations for authenticity judgments. However, their ability to interpret text within images may also expose these judgments to misleading semantic cues. We systematically evaluate typographic attack strategies across detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs, considering both real-to-fake and fake-to-real attacks. Our results show that reasoning modes generally exhibit greater vulnerability than direct modes and that attack effectiveness exhibits pronounced directional asymmetry. Moreover, larger models tend to exhibit higher clean detection accuracy but also higher attack success rates. We further examine attack robustness under image and text transformations and investigate whether overlays indicating the correct class can aid error correction. Together, these analyses characterize how typographic attacks influence authenticity judgments and expose limitations of current VLM-based AIGI detection systems.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地用于人工智能生成图像（AIGI）检测，并为真实性判断提供自然语言解释。 然而，它们对图像中文本的解读能力也可能使这些判断受到误导性语义线索的影响。 我们系统性地评估了面向检测、开放权重和商业 VLM 的排版攻击策略，同时考虑了从真实到伪造以及从伪造到真实的攻击。 我们的结果表明，推理模式通常比直接模式更容易受到攻击，且攻击效果呈现出明显的方向性不对称性。 此外，模型规模越大，其正常检测准确率往往越高，但攻击成功率也相应更高。 我们还进一步检验了图像和文本变换下的攻击鲁棒性，并研究了标注正确类别的覆盖层是否有助于错误纠正。 综合来看，这些分析揭示了排版攻击如何影响真实性判断，并暴露了当前基于 VLM 的 AIGI 检测系统的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Advances in generative modeling have improved the visual fidelity and diversity of AI-generated images (AIGIs). As AIGIs become harder to distinguish from photographs, AIGI detection has attracted growing interest, as reflected in the development of diverse benchmarks [ 26 , 29 ] . Meanwhile, vision-language models (VLMs) trained on large-scale multimodal data support diverse applications through visual recognition and reasoning [ 6 , 3 ] . In AIGI detection, VLMs can combine visual evidence and semantic knowledge for classification and natural-language explanations. Recent studies develop detection-oriented VLMs through task-specific training to improve authenticity classification and artifact explanation [ 25 , 10 , 21 , 24 , 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 生成式建模的进步提升了人工智能生成图像（AIGI）的视觉保真度和多样性。 随着 AIGI 越来越难以与照片区分，AIGI 检测吸引了越来越多的关注，这体现在各种基准测试的开发中 [ 26 , 29 ] 。 与此同时，在大规模多模态数据上训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过视觉识别和推理支持了多样化的应用 [ 6 , 3 ] 。 在 AIGI 检测中，VLM 能够结合视觉证据和语义知识进行分类并提供自然语言解释。 近期的研究通过任务特定的训练开发出了以检测为导向的 VLM，从而提升了真实性分类和伪影解释的能力 [ 25 , 10 , 21 , 24 , 20 ] 。

paragraphs.en: However, broader VLM use raises practical concerns about robustness to adversarial manipulation of textual and visual inputs [ 27 , 19 ] . Among these, typographic attacks introduce misleading text into images [ 7 , 16 ] . Such attacks can add or modify text using standard image-editing tools without accessing the model’s internal prompts. Prior work examines misleading text and related artifacts in visual recognition and geolocation [ 16 , 17 , 28 ] , while FigStep uses typographic prompts to bypass safety alignment [ 8 ] . Related studies also report a preference for text over visual information when modalities conflict [ 4 ] . For AIGI detection, overlaid authenticity claims may thus bias detector judgments without establishing image provenance. Despite these threats, the robustness of VLM-based AIGI detection to typographic attacks remains underexplored . An initial study [ 13 ] reports a 6.6% attack success rate (ASR) against zero-shot GPT-4o detection on Celeb-DF [ 14 ] using a file-path overlay suggesting authentic provenance. However, evaluating one VLM and overlay for fake-to-real evasion leaves several important issues unclear, such as how vulnerability varies across general-purpose and specialized detectors and typographic designs, and whether attacks succeed in both directions (real → \rightarrow fake, fake → \rightarrow real).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，更广泛的 VLM 应用引发了关于其对文本和视觉输入对抗性操纵的鲁棒性的实际担忧 [27, 19]。 其中，排版攻击会在图像中插入误导性文本 [7, 16]。 此类攻击可以使用标准的图像编辑工具添加或修改文本，而无需访问模型内部的提示。 先前的研究探讨了视觉识别和地理位置中的误导性文本及相关伪影 [16, 17, 28]，而 FigStep 则利用排版提示绕过安全对齐机制 [8]。 相关研究还指出，当不同模态的信息发生冲突时，模型更倾向于优先采信文本信息而非视觉信息 [4]。 因此，在 AIGI 检测中，叠加的 authenticity 声明可能会影响检测器的判断，却无法确定图像的真实来源。 尽管存在这些威胁，基于 VLM 的 AIGI 检测对排版攻击的鲁棒性仍尚未得到充分研究。 一项初步研究 [13] 报告称，在 Celeb-DF [14] 数据集上针对零样本 GPT-4o 检测的攻击成功率（ASR）为 6.6%，该攻击通过叠加暗示真实来源的文件路径实现。 然而，仅评估一种 VLM 和一种用于规避“假转真”检测的叠加方法，仍留下了若干重要问题未明，例如：不同通用型和专用型检测器及排版设计之间的脆弱性差异，以及攻击是否能在两个方向（真实 → \rightarrow 虚假、虚假 → \rightarrow 真实）均成功实施。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we systematically evaluate typographic attacks against various VLMs (detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs), comparing four adapted attacks with a random-text control in both directions. We find that reasoning modes are generally more vulnerable than direct modes, effective cues differ by attack direction, and larger models achieve higher clean accuracy while often exhibiting higher ASR. We also test attack robustness under JPEG compression [ 23 ] , downsampling, multilingual perturbations [ 5 ] , and typographical errors [ 2 ] . Furthermore, inspired by Amicable Aid [ 11 ] , we apply overlays supporting the correct class to initially misclassified images, probing whether typographic vulnerability reflects a broader tendency to follow textual class cues.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们系统性地评估了针对各种视觉语言模型（检测导向型、开放权重型和商业型视觉语言模型）的排版攻击，并将四种经过调整的攻攻击与随机文本对照在两个方向上进行了比较。 我们发现，推理模式通常比直接模式更容易受到攻击，有效提示因攻击方向而异，且模型规模越大，其干净准确率越高，但通常也会出现更高的自动语音识别率。 我们还测试了攻击在 JPEG 压缩 [ 23 ]、降采样、多语言扰动 [ 5 ] 和排版错误 [ 2 ] 条件下的鲁棒性。 此外，受 Amicable Aid [ 11 ] 的启发，我们将支持正确类别的叠加层应用于最初被错误分类的图像，以探究排版脆弱性是否反映了更广泛地遵循文本类别提示的趋势。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献可概括如下：

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, we provide the first systematic assessment of typographic vulnerability in VLM-based AIGI detection .
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，我们首次对基于VLM的AIGI检测中的排版漏洞进行了系统性评估。

paragraphs.en: We characterize typographic vulnerability across inference modes, attack directions, model families, and scales, revealing systematic differences in how VLMs respond to textual cues.
paragraphs.zh: 我们描述了不同推理模式、攻击方向、模型家族和规模下的排版脆弱性，揭示了视觉语言模型（VLM）对文本提示响应的系统性差异。

paragraphs.en: We assess attack persistence under image and text transformations and use correct-class overlays to probe the broader influence of textual cues on authenticity judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了图像和文本变换下的攻击持续性，并利用正确类别的覆盖层来探究文本线索对真实性判断的更广泛影响。

Veritas [ 21 , 20 ] incorporates planning and self-reflection to improve generalization.

We systematically evaluate these vulnerabilities across general-purpose and detection-oriented VLMs.

paragraphs.en: Tab. 1 and Tab. 2 show that typographic attacks substantially compromise AIGI detection across the evaluated model families. Although Random Text also induces errors, Class Label and Instruction consistently achieve higher ASR. In particular, Instruction outperforms Random Text despite matching its character count and rendering settings, indicating that textual semantics contribute to attack effectiveness beyond mere visual occlusion.

paragraphs.en: Direct vs. Reasoning. Across the four adapted attacks, reasoning mode yields higher ASR than direct mode in 42 of 48 matched comparisons, with particularly large increases for BusterX++ and Qwen. Qualitative reasoning outputs in Fig. 2(a) further suggest that reasoning can incorporate misleading text into the evidence supporting its verdict. While this vulnerability is generally more pronounced in reasoning mode, its magnitude varies across models and attack directions. For example, the direct–reasoning gap tends to be smaller for GLM, and some F → \rightarrow R attacks on Qwen with GenImage are less effective in reasoning mode.
paragraphs.zh: 直接模式与推理模式。 在四种经过调整的攻击中，推理模式在 48 组匹配比较中的 42 组中比直接模式获得了更高的 ASR，其中 BusterX++ 和 Qwen 的提升尤为显著。 图 2(a) 中的定性推理结果进一步表明，推理模式可能会将误导性文本纳入支持其判断的证据中。 尽管这种漏洞在推理模式中通常更为明显，但其严重程度因模型和攻击方向而异。 例如，GLM 的直接模式与推理模式之间的差距往往较小，而针对 Qwen 的某些 F → \rightarrow R 攻击在推理模式中的效果则较弱。

paragraphs.en: Model Families. Across all three model families–detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs–vulnerability depends strongly on the attack type and direction, and no family is unifomrly robust. On Ivy-Fake, Ivy and Veritas++ show relatively low R → \rightarrow F ASRs but remain highly susceptible to the Instruction attack in the F → \rightarrow R direction, whereas BusterX++ exhibits severe vulnerability to the File Path attack in the R → \rightarrow F direction. On GenImage, the Logo attack likewise achieves high F → \rightarrow R ASRs against commercial models, reaching 58.92% for GPT-5.4 and 37.99% for Sonnet 5.
paragraphs.zh: 模型家族。 在所有三个模型家族——检测导向型、开放权重型和商用 VLM——中，漏洞严重性强烈依赖于攻击类型和方向，且没有任何一个模型家族是全面稳健的。 在 Ivy-Fake 上，Ivy 和 Veritas++ 表现出相对较低的 R → F ASR，但在 F → R 方向上仍极易受到指令攻击；而 BusterX++ 则在 R → F 方向上对文件路径攻击表现出严重的脆弱性。 在 GenImage 上，Logo 攻击同样在商用模型上实现了较高的 F → R ASR，其中 GPT-5.4 达到了 58.92%，Sonnet 5 达到了 37.99%。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate attack robustness on a shared subset of 100 real and 100 fake images that are correctly classified by both Ivy and Veritas++. For image perturbations, we apply JPEG compression ( Q ∈ { 75 , 50 , 25 } Q\in\{75,50,25\} ) and downsampling ( s ∈ { 0.9 , 0.75 , 0.5 } s\in\{0.9,0.75,0.5\} ) to attacked images. For text perturbations, we translate English overlays into Korean, Chinese, and Spanish, and also introduce substitutions with neighboring QWERTY keys at nominal rates of 10 % 10\% , 20 % 20\% , and 30 % 30\% . Characters are selected with these rates for short prompts and word occurrences for File Path, with one character modified per selected word. Logo is evaluated only under image transformations. Fig. 3 presents combined ASR averaged over both models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个共享子集上评估攻击的鲁棒性，该子集包含 100 张真实图像和 100 张虚假图像，且这两类图像都能被 Ivy 和 Veritas++ 正确分类。 对于图像扰动，我们对受攻击的图像应用 JPEG 压缩（Q ∈ {75, 50, 25}）和降采样（s ∈ {0.9, 0.75, 0.5}）。 对于文本扰动，我们将英文覆盖文本翻译成韩语、中文和西班牙语，并以 10%、20% 和 30% 的名义替换率引入 QWERTY 键盘相邻键位的替换。 对于简短提示，按这些比率选择字符；对于文件路径中的单词出现情况，则每选择一个单词修改其中一个字符。 Logo 仅在图像变换条件下进行评估。 图 3 展示了两个模型的平均 ASR 综合结果。

paragraphs.en: JPEG compression and downsampling increase ASR above the reference, but accompanying clean-image errors suggest that this reflects weakened visual evidence rather than stronger textual influence alone. Text perturbations instead reveal robustness that depends on attack design and direction. Translation sharply reduces R → \rightarrow F ASR for Class Label and Instruction, while Instruction and File Path retain substantial F → \rightarrow R success across languages. Typos show a similar attack-specific pattern, progressively weakening Instruction while leaving File Path comparatively stable, possibly because its path structure remains recognizable.

paragraphs.en: To further understand whether attack success reflects textual semantics rather than visual occlusion alone, we reverse the setting following Amicable Aid [ 11 ] . Each model is evaluated on 100 images it misclassifies without typographies. We then add typography supporting the ground-truth class. For example, a real image misclassified as fake receives a REAL cue, and vice versa. Recovery rate measures the fraction of these errors corrected, with Random Text as a non-targeted control.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步理解攻击成功究竟是反映了文本语义，而不仅仅是视觉遮挡，我们遵循 Amicable Aid [ 11 ] 的方法反转了设置。 每个模型都在 100 张没有排版文字的误分类图像上进行评估。 然后，我们添加支持真实标签类别的排版文字。 例如，一张被错误分类为虚假的真实图像会收到一个“真实”提示，反之亦然。 恢复率衡量了这些错误中被纠正的比例，其中随机文本用作非目标性对照。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Tab. 4 , all four aids outperform Random Text in average recovery, indicating that semantic agreement with the ground truth matters beyond the presence of text alone. paragraphs.en: We examine how overlay position, font size, and opacity affect attack effectiveness on Ivy and Veritas++. Tab. 5 reports ASR aggregated over four attacks and both directions, excluding Random Text. Position has a modest and model-dependent effect, with pooled ASR ranging from 34.31% to 37.94%. Font size and opacity show clearer trends: pooled ASR increases from 22.69% to 36.63% as the font-size fraction increases from 0.02 to 0.10, and from 12.50% to 34.31% as opacity increases from 0.05 to 0.95. However, a font-size fraction of 0.10 frequently causes rendering failures.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we systematically evaluated four adapted typographic attacks against detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs for AIGI detection. The results reveal substantial susceptibility, with reasoning modes generally exhibiting higher ASR and attack effectiveness varying markedly by direction. Additional analyses show that higher clean accuracy does not ensure lower ASR, common image transformations fail to reliably mitigate attacks, and truth-aligned typography can recover selected detection errors. These findings highlight the need for VLM-based AIGI detectors to distinguish overlaid authenticity claims from visual evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们系统性地评估了四种经过调整的字体攻击方法，针对用于 AIGI 检测的检测导向型、开放权重型和商用视觉语言模型（VLM）。 研究结果表明，这些模型存在显著的可攻击性，其中推理模式通常表现出更高的攻击成功率（ASR），且攻击效果因方向不同而差异明显。 进一步分析显示，较高的干净准确率并不一定意味着较低的攻击成功率（ASR）；常见的图像变换无法可靠地缓解攻击；而与事实对齐的字体设计则能够纠正部分检测错误。 这些发现凸显了基于 VLM 的 AIGI 检测器需要区分叠加的真实性声明与视觉证据的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Discussion. Our experiments identify greater vulnerability in reasoning modes, but do not fully explain why these modes are often more susceptible or what determines attack success and failure. Investigating these factors could inform new typographic attacks specifically targeting reasoning-based VLMs.
